title: StrategyQuant Review 2026: Price, Features & Verdict
description: StrategyQuant review: genetic strategy generation, walk-forward and Monte Carlo tests, MT4 and MT5 export, prices and the free trial to check.
author: Sophia Reynolds
excerpt: StrategyQuant generates trading strategies with genetic programming and exports code, but prices on its reference blog are not confirmed.
content:
StrategyQuant is strategy generation software that builds trading systems with genetic programming and exports them as code. It does not connect to brokers and does not hold client funds. The reference page is a VPS company's blog, which sells its own hosting, so this review checks the claims against the official site where it could.

StrategyQuant at a Glance

Here is what the source page states and what it leaves out.

CategoryWhat the source says
Product typeStrategy generation and testing software, not a broker
MethodGenetic programming with walk-forward optimisation and Monte Carlo tests
Export targetsMT4 and MT5 are named most often. Also TradeStation, MultiCharts, cTrader and generic C# or Java
Free trial14 days with full functionality, per the official site. No card required
PricesNot shown on the official homepage. The reference blog lists Starter, Professional and Ultimate editions, but these are not confirmed
PlatformsWindows is the main platform. Mac users are pointed to Boot Camp, Parallels or a Windows VPS
Affiliate disclosureThe reference blog sells VPS hosting and has an affiliate programme, but does not state a commission on StrategyQuant

Items come from the reference page and the official site where we checked them. We have not tested the product.

Is StrategyQuant Legit? What the Claims Show

Strategy generation and testing

The software builds strategies from indicators, price patterns, time filters and entry and exit rules, then tests them with walk-forward and Monte Carlo methods. It is a research tool, so results depend on the data and the settings you choose.

Prices on the reference blog

The blog lists one-time prices for three editions and suggests a first-year total with hardware and VPS costs. The official homepage did not show those prices, so confirm the current price and renewal terms with StrategyQuant before you buy.

Platform support

The reference blog says the software runs on Windows only, while the official site lists Windows, Mac and Linux. Check the current system requirements for your own computer before you buy.

StrategyQuant Costs and Pricing

The official homepage shows a 14-day free trial but no current prices. The reference blog lists one-time editions, and renewal for updates is optional. Check the price, renewal and any VPS cost before you buy.

Our standard minimum deposit for this review is 250 in the reader's local currency. Software licences do not use a deposit, so budget for the licence and any hosting instead.

Who Is Behind StrategyQuant

The official site names no legal entity or address and makes no regulatory claims. It says the software is not a broker or adviser and does not hold client funds. The reference blog's publisher is a VPS seller, and its own risk disclaimer says profitability is not guaranteed.

Before You Buy: A Short Checklist

  • Read the current price and renewal terms on the official StrategyQuant site.
  • Use the 14-day trial to test the export to your own platform before you buy.
  • Check the system requirements for your own operating system.
  • Verify any performance figure on an independent platform such as Myfxbook, rather than trusting a sales page.

Risks to Keep in Mind

Generated strategies often fail when they move from backtests to live markets, and the reference blog itself says most fail. Overfitting is a real risk with genetic search. The software does not connect to brokers, so you must run and monitor the exported code yourself.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is StrategyQuant legit?

StrategyQuant is established strategy software with a free trial. The official site makes no regulatory claims because it is not a broker, so judge it as software and test the trial first.

How much does StrategyQuant cost?

The official homepage shows no prices. The reference blog lists editions around $1,290 to $4,900, which should be confirmed on the official site before you buy.

Does StrategyQuant have a free trial?

Yes. The official site lists a 14-day trial with full functionality and no card required.

Does StrategyQuant work on Mac?

The main software is Windows based. Mac users are directed to Boot Camp, Parallels or a Windows VPS, and the official site lists Mac support too, so check the current requirements.

Can StrategyQuant connect to my broker?

No. It exports code to platforms such as MT4 and MT5, which you then run yourself.

Our Verdict on StrategyQuant

StrategyQuant is real strategy generation software with a clear trial and export options. Prices, platform support and the reference blog's VPS links need checking on the official site before you buy, and every backtest result should be tested live with your own account. Our rating reflects these gaps. We will revisit it once the details above are confirmed.
